title: task
description: One row per task. Every field merges on its own.

estimate.description: Whole laps, offered from 1 to 32. Laps done may pass it.

parent.description: The task this is a subtask of. One level.

repeat.description: Null, every day, or chosen weekdays (a weekly task is one weekday). Rules: protocol.md section 12.

days.description: Weekday mask. Bit 0 is Monday, bit 6 is Sunday.

when.description: Free words for when in the day: after dinner. No longer shown or edited; kept so older rows are not dropped.

time.description: Local time of day on its due day, 24 hour, 15:30. Null for none. Means nothing without a due day.

work_ms.description: This task's own length for a lap, in ms. Null for the account's.

short_ms.description: This task's own length for a short break, in ms. Null for the account's.

long_ms.description: This task's own length for a long break, in ms. Null for the account's.

done.description: Server-time ms it was done, null while open.

order.description: Fractional index. Ties break by row id.

deleted.description: Server-time ms it was deleted, null while alive. Restorable for 30 days.
